title: Vehicle
description: A kind of craft a person can board, and the ground it crosses. Repeatable, the way an `item` is repeatable: canon already holds four *named* vessels -- the Battered Ekranoplan, the Kelpfang, the Leviathan's Rib and the Survival Train -- as `place` entities with `kind: vessel`, and those stay where they are. The split is the one items and artifacts already have. A reed raft is a vehicle and there are hundreds; the Kelpfang is one, and it has a story.

kind.description: Coarse on purpose, like `place.kind`. The distinction that matters is a raft from a ship, not a dhow from a ketch.

crosses.description: Biomes this can travel over. The whole mechanical point of a vehicle: it makes ground passable that walking cannot cross, which is what `affords: ["cross"]` says about an item and this says at the scale of a journey.

capacity.description: People it carries, crew included. A number canon is often guessing at, which is why it is optional.

built_by.description: The process that makes one. Almost always `process_boatbuilding`; a cart is not.

exemplars.description: `place_` ids of named craft of this kind. **One-directional on purpose** -- the vehicle names the vessel and the vessel does not name the vehicle back, so the two cannot drift. This is the ruling factions already have with `members`, applied again.

epochs.description: Epoch ids. Absent means every epoch, which is right for a raft and badly wrong for a ground-effect craft.
